messages:
sasha: Heads-up — I opened a Terraform PR that changes the default runtime knob for max tokens via the ConfigMap. This flips model_runtime.max_tokens from "2048" to "1024" for the app. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/487. Need quick infra review before we apply to staging.

ken: Which ConfigMap are we talking about and how is it mounted? env var or file? If the binary reads env we can hot-reload, otherwise rollout will trigger pod restarts. Can you paste the snippet?

sasha: It's the k8s ConfigMap named redwood-app-config in the redwood namespace. I updated it via TF (kubernetes_config_map). Snippet from PR:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: redwood-app-config
  namespace: redwood
data:
  model_runtime.max_tokens: "1024"
  feature_flags: >-
    {"enable_dynamic_batching": true}
```

maya: If the runtime reads the file path, we need a rolling restart. Also note per-model overrides live in the model annotation (model.redwood.com/overrides) and should take precedence. Did you touch any helm values or only the TF-managed ConfigMap?

sasha: Only the TF resource. I left a note in the PR about per-model annotations — they won’t be affected. No secrets changed.

rachel: Quick ops check: since you changed a kubernetes_config_map resource in TF, we need to be careful about state drift. Any resource name changes or keys renamed? If not, plan/apply should be straightforward, but we should avoid simultaneous applies to prod.

sasha: No renames. I ran a local terraform plan and applied on a staging cluster clone successfully. Plan output was clean. My rollout proposal: apply to staging today at 16:00 PT, run smoke tests, then promote to prod tomorrow with a canary label (traffic=canary 10%).

infra-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan finished for staging (run id: run_2026_03_17_2330). No resource replacements.

ken: LGTM from infra side. @rachel @maya any objections to me approving the PR and scheduling the apply?

rachel: No objections. Make sure to tag the apply with the run_id and document the smoke test steps in the PR description. Also request a short on-call window.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll add an integration test that asserts per-model override still wins (deploy a test model with annotation override and hit the endpoint).

sasha: Thanks all — I'll update the PR with the smoke test checklist and schedule the staging apply.
